title: Electronic Commerce: Exam, April 2021
programme: Bachelor of Business Information Technology / information Technology
instructions: ATTEMPT QUESTION ONE AND ANY OTHER TWO QUESTIONS

parts.text: What do you understand by the term e-commerce and explain its three key features?
Examine the role of the internet in e-commerce and state three reasons why the internet is viewed as special.
Enumerate the many advantages that make an organization develop a website.
Identify and explain the drivers/factors for using the internet for business.
Citing examples, discuss the eight main models for e-commerce.
Examine the benefits that consumers derive from e-commerce.
E-mail contributes extensively in e-commerce. Explain its defining features.
Using relevant examples, explain the following terms as used in e-commerce and e-marketing.
Using a table, distinguish the benefits of e-commerce for companies and those for customers. Justify your answer.
Discuss at least eight internet business models. Justify your answers by highlighting the impact caused by each of the business models on the Kenyan economy.
Propose ways that institutions of learning may use to forge customer loyalty in a competitive market.
Citing examples, discuss the negative impacts of e-commerce on society.
By use of a table, state the classification of distribution channel models that retailers use to sell their products.
